**Finding: deviation (medium severity) — RENEWAL**

The renewal terms are buried in the mis-numbered Section 13 (paragraph p0078, rendered under the § 12 Indemnity heading rather than a term/renewal section, contrary to the planner's "likely absent" hint).

What the document already does well:
- **Renewal term:** successive **one-year** periods — matches the preferred 12-month position.
- **Exit window:** either party may give non-renewal notice **30 days** prior to term end — already at the preferred ≤ 30 days, well inside the walk-away threshold.

What was missing:
- **No vendor renewal reminder** — the customer bears the full burden of tracking the renewal date.
- **No renewal price cap.** Section 6 (p0047) freezes Hosting Services costs only "for a period of one year from the date of this Agreement," so uplift at each renewal is entirely uncapped after year one. (The most-favoured-rate promise in the same sentence limits relative pricing but not absolute increases.)

Redline (validated, ok:true): inserted into p0078 a requirement that TrueLink notify Client of each upcoming renewal at least 60 days before term end, and a cap on renewal fees at the lesser of CPI over the preceding 12 months and 3%. Fallback of 5% offered in the comment.
